content.text:
I submitted **index 106** (Ca 0.20, Cu 0.46, V 0.34) as the best composition, with a measured EQE of **0.274%**. Only 3 of the 139 compositions were measured, so a better one elsewhere in the library can't be ruled out.

I spent all 3 EQE measurements on the low-Ca, Cu-rich edge. Copper vanadates are the known photoactive phases in this system, and Ca is not expected to contribute. I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so no phases were actually identified.

| Index | Ca / Cu / V | Cu:V | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 134 | 0.22 / 0.54 / 0.24 | ~2.2 | 0.166 |
| **106** | 0.20 / 0.46 / 0.34 | ~1.34 | **0.274** |
| 89 | 0.21 / 0.39 / 0.40 | ~1.0 | 0.213 |

Index 106 beat both the more Cu-rich and the more V-rich point. That suggests a local peak around Cu:V of 1.3–1.5, but this rests on just three points along one line.

- **Main gap:** I never measured the V-rich or Ca-rich compositions (Cu below 0.15). I skipped them because I didn't expect an active phase there, not because of any data.
- **Worth measuring next:** indices 105 and 121, which sit either side of 106, would show whether it is truly the peak.
